title: Audit Windows path tests and plant a directory separator where one is missing
goal: Each test of a Windows path fix in _tools/test_*.py (git revision reads in factdiff and kbgit, kbingest masking and link checks, the raw-read hint's path parsing, launcher paths) plants its path at least one directory below the root; the commit lists every test audited and what changed; a planted native-separator bug in each covered function fails its test.
